items.difficulty_reason: 15 行、基上层截段的逐点刻画：单射由基上层条件唯一性；反向把 (*) 族用基元覆盖局部实现为 sigma_i，茎相等给基元 V_{ijy} 上一致，sheaf condition (**) 粘出 s。承重两步（覆盖实现、粘合）都在 span 内；1 个引用标（定义引两次合并一条）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-condition-star-sections (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4106-4123

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: injectivity from the sheaf uniqueness on the basis, and conversely cover U by basis elements carrying the local sections, use equality on stalks to find basis sub-opens where the sections agree, and glue by the sheaf condition (source lines 4125-4140)
